description: This Java source file contains integration tests for client loans, specifically testing multiple disbursements, loan statuses, and repayment schedules within the Apache Fineract project. It defines a test class with several test cases that create loan products, apply for loans with tranches, perform disbursals, repayments, and verify the resulting loan states and schedules.

classes.name: ClientLoanMultipleDisbursementsIntegrationTest
classes.description: A test class for verifying multiple disbursals, repayment schedules, and loan statuses in the Fineract loan module.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes REST assured configuration, request and response specifications, and helper instance before each test.

methods.name: createLoanProduct
methods.description: Creates a loan product with parameters for multiple disbursal capability.

methods.name: applyForLoanApplicationWithTranches
methods.description: Applies for a loan with specific tranche details for disbursal.

methods.name: createTrancheDetail
methods.description: Constructs a tranche detail map with expected disbursement date and amount.

methods.name: checkThatAllMultiDisbursalsAppearOnLoanScheduleAndOutStandingBalanceIsZeroTest
methods.description: Test case that verifies all scheduled disbursals are reflected in the loan schedule with correct balances.

methods.name: checkThatAllMultiDisbursalsAppearOnLoanScheduleAndOutStandingBalanceIsZeroButLoanGotReopenedTest
methods.description: Test case that verifies behavior when a loan is closed after partial repayment and then re-disbursed.

methods.name: checkThatAllMultiDisbursalsAppearOnLoanScheduleAndOutStandingBalanceIsZeroButLoanGotReopenedFromOverPaidTest
methods.description: Test case that examines re-opening a loan after overpayment and subsequent disbursal.
